title: Admin — generic shell + composed console
description: Access-gated admin surfaces behind one slug, in two variants. shell: a minimal generic single-instance admin shell (a titled card region + a buildAdminStats() factory + SliceAdminLabels) over convex/features/admin — zero composed sections, wire your own. console: the composed multi-section console — an access-gated two-column shell driving a 26-section registry that mounts OTHER rr slices (users → user-management, roles → rbac-roles, analytics/audit, AI → ai-admin, tenants → platform-admin) via a components map, over convex/features/admin_console (ac_leads, ac_nav_items). Install one with `npx rr add admin shell|console`, or both with `npx rr add admin`; each variant pulls ONLY its own convex backend (per-variant convex gating). NOT the multi-tenant control plane — that stays the separate `platform-admin` slice (referenced here as the `tenants` section provider).
